title: Hvorfor ikke...?????
body:
Hvordan kan man dog få sig selv til at lave en app der supporterer ældre modeller ure men ikke de nyere....???

Jeg kan se i app store at health appen suporterer S2 og S3 urene men ikke Galaxy watch...? Jeg har et Galaxy Watch 46 mm og den bliver ikke supporteret....??? Meget underligt og frustrerende.....!!!! Health appen er installeret på uret også og heller ikke den synkroniserer data med kontoen...!!!??? Kære udviklere....: få det nu fixet...!!! Det kan da ikke passe et firma som Samsung ikke kan få sådan en simpel ting til at fungere.....

author: Madsi2002

title: Sync has gone from bad to not working.
body:
Started to use the app with my S Watch in Jan 19. Sync worked every day and with every activity. 

Updated the app regularly. Every time the sync got worse incl. loss of all data at one of the updates. 

Since latest up nothing is working with sync with S Watch. Have tried re-start, re-load,
clear the S Watch and reinstalled S Watch & S Heath app and turned BT on/off on both devices. Nothing works!

Real pity as this app actually worked in the past.

UPDATE:
After a some updates sync has improved significantly. Only missing element would be alignment of targeted health activities between watch and app.

author: MStehr

title: Good but...
body:
The functionalities of the app are very well designed and it easy to follow up your records at the end of the day.
The weekly summary could be better in structure. Information wise I find it ok.
The watch fits nice in my wrist.

The big issue for me, is the synchronization with apple mobile and that some days the app shows double values to the ones shown in the watch (galaxy active).
This is a BIG ISSUE!
I really hope that it’s fixed cause it start happening after the return period and I’m somehow stuck with it.

title: Bluetooth often failing
body: I like both the watch Gear S3 as well as the app Samsung Health. But the Bluetooth connection often fails and although I can see the battery etc of the watch in the other app Galaxy Watch the Samsung Health app often states that there is no connection to any wristband device although there is indeed! And hence no data are transferred from the watch to the app. It’s very annoying and I delete the watch in the Bluetooth settings and start over, but it doesn’t help. Why does the app “forget” the watch when they are clearly connects under the Bluetooth settings???
